## Employee Handbook 2026

People Operations

## 1. About This Handbook

This handbook describes the employment policies of Halvorsen Industrial Systems. It applies to all permanent and fixed-term staff in every country where the company operates, unless local law requires otherwise.

This edition of the handbook takes effect on 1 March 2026 and supersedes the 2023 edition. The handbook is owned by the People Operations department.

The handbook is formally reviewed every 18 months. Questions about policy interpretation must be raised with the employee's HR Business Partner within 10 working days of the event in question.

## 2. Working Hours and Remote Work

Our standard working week is 37.5 hours. Flexible working is encouraged where operational needs allow, but some collaboration time is protected for every team.

Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time, during which employees are expected to be available. Office-based roles may work remotely for a maximum of 3 days per week.

New remote-eligible employees receive a one-time home office stipend of EUR 450. Company laptops are refreshed every 36 months.

Overtime must be pre-approved by a line manager and is compensated at 150% of the base hourly rate.

## 7. Code of Conduct

We expect every employee to act with integrity and to avoid situations where personal interests could conflict with those of the company.

Employees may not accept gifts or hospitality with a value above EUR 75 from suppliers or customers. Potential conflicts of interest must be disclosed to the Compliance Office within 14 days of becoming aware of them.

The confidential whistleblowing hotline is operated by an independent provider and is available 24 hours a day. Breaches of the code of conduct are investigated by the Ethics Committee.

## 8. Health and Safety

Safety is our first priority. All staff must follow site-specific safety rules in addition to the general rules below.

Each site must have at least one trained first aider for every 25 employees present. Fire evacuation drills are held twice a year at every site.

Workplace injuries must be recorded on form HS-7 within 24 hours. Safety footwear is reimbursed up to EUR 120 per year for production staff.

## 5. Information Security

Every employee is responsible for protecting company and customer information. The Information Security Office publishes detailed standards on the intranet.

Passwords for company accounts must be at least 14 characters long. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all remote access to company systems.

Suspected security incidents must be reported to the Security Operations Centre within 2 hours of discovery. Workstations must lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity.

All employees must complete phishing awareness training every quarter.

## 4. Internal and Supplier Audits

Audits are planned on a risk basis and carried out by trained auditors who are independent of the area audited.

Every process in the QMS is internally audited at least once every 12 months. Critical suppliers are audited on site every 24 months.

Internal auditors must complete a 3-day lead auditor course before conducting audits. Major audit findings must have a corrective action plan submitted within 10 days.

Suppliers with a quality score below 70 are placed on probation.

## Quality and Compliance Manual

Quality Department rev. 7

## 1. Scope and Certification

This manual defines the quality management system of Halvorsen Industrial Systems for the design, manufacture and servicing of industrial pumps and controllers.

The quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015 under certificate number QMS-48213. The certification body is Nordic Assurance Services.

The Quality Director is the management representative for the QMS. A management review of the QMS is held every 6 months.

The quality manual itself is reviewed annually by the Document Control team.

## 3. Nonconformance and Corrective Action

Any product, process or supplier nonconformance is recorded in the quality system and assigned an owner.

Nonconformance reports (NCRs) must be closed within 21 days of being raised. Root cause analysis for corrective actions uses the 8D method.

The effectiveness of each corrective action is verified 90 days after implementation. Customer complaints must be acknowledged within 2 working days.

A Material Review Board meets every Tuesday to disposition nonconforming material.

## 5. Product Release and Traceability

Finished products are released only after all inspection and test steps defined in the control plan are complete.

Every pump undergoes a hydrostatic pressure test at 1.5 times its rated pressure before release. Pump serial numbers follow the format HX-YYWW-NNNN.

Traceability records for safety-critical components are retained for 15 years. Final inspection sampling follows ISO 2859-1 with an AQL of 0.65.

The Quality Engineer signs the certificate of conformity for each shipment.

## 2. Working Hours and Remote Work

Our standard working week is 37.5 hours. Flexible working is encouraged where operational needs allow, but some collaboration time is protected for every team.

Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time, during which employees are expected to be available. Office-based roles may work remotely for a maximum of 3 days per week.

New remote-eligible employees receive a one-time home office stipend of EUR 450. Company laptops are refreshed every 36 months.

Overtime must be pre-approved by a line manager and is compensated at 150% of the base hourly rate.

## 3. Leave Entitlements

All leave requests are submitted through the HR portal. Managers should respond to requests within five working days.

Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year in addition to public holidays. A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the following year.

The primary caregiver is entitled to 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Employees may self-certify sickness absence for up to 3 consecutive days before a medical certificate is required.

Bereavement leave of 5 paid days is granted on the death of an immediate family member.

## Quality and Compliance Manual

Quality Department rev. 7

## 1. Scope and Certification

This manual defines the quality management system of Halvorsen Industrial Systems for the design, manufacture and servicing of industrial pumps and controllers.

The quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015 under certificate number QMS-48213. The certification body is Nordic Assurance Services.

The Quality Director is the management representative for the QMS. A management review of the QMS is held every 6 months.

The quality manual itself is reviewed annually by the Document Control team.

## 4. Internal and Supplier Audits

Audits are planned on a risk basis and carried out by trained auditors who are independent of the area audited.

Every process in the QMS is internally audited at least once every 12 months. Critical suppliers are audited on site every 24 months.

Internal auditors must complete a 3-day lead auditor course before conducting audits. Major audit findings must have a corrective action plan submitted within 10 days.

Suppliers with a quality score below 70 are placed on probation.

## 5. Product Release and Traceability

Finished products are released only after all inspection and test steps defined in the control plan are complete.

Every pump undergoes a hydrostatic pressure test at 1.5 times its rated pressure before release. Pump serial numbers follow the format HX-YYWW-NNNN.

Traceability records for safety-critical components are retained for 15 years. Final inspection sampling follows ISO 2859-1 with an AQL of 0.65.

The Quality Engineer signs the certificate of conformity for each shipment.
